metadata.label: Step Id
metadata.description:
Identity of this step within the workflow, reported by every execution of it and
matching a node of the descriptor's graph — so a run can be traced back to the
exact call that ran, the one in the `if` arm rather than the `else`. Name it
(`stepId = "charge-card"`) for a step you want to follow: a chosen id survives
edits that shift the generated `<activity>#<ordinal>`. Must be a constant string;
an id another step already has is suffixed, with a warning.

metadata.label: Additional Values
metadata.description: Capture key value pairs

metadata.label: Retry Policy
metadata.description: Engine retry strategy when the activity fails: no automatic retry (an AI agent may still re-invoke it), automatic backoff retries, or a human review task

metadata.label: Max Retries
metadata.description: Maximum retry attempts (default: 3)

metadata.label: Retry Delay
metadata.description: Initial delay in seconds before the first retry (default: 1.0)

metadata.label: Retry Backoff
metadata.description: Multiplier applied to delay after each retry (default: 2.0)

metadata.label: Max Retry Delay
metadata.description: Cap on the delay between retries, in seconds

metadata.label: Reviewer Roles
metadata.description: Role(s) permitted to decide the human review, e.g. "manager" or ["finance", "manager"]. Leave empty to allow any role.

metadata.label: Title
metadata.description: Short summary shown in the reviewer's inbox. Defaults to a phrase naming the activity being reviewed.

metadata.label: Description
metadata.description: Context shown with the decision. Defaults to a description of the failure and the outcomes available.

metadata.label: Timeout
metadata.description: How long to wait for a decision, e.g. {hours: 4}. Empty waits indefinitely.
